description: This file defines the StripeService class which manages interactions with the Stripe API, including account linking, session creation, and credential validation within a NestJS application.

classes.name: StripeService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to interact with Stripe API for account management, session creation, and credential validation.

methods.name: getStripe
methods.description: Returns the initialized Stripe client instance.

methods.name: getStripeRedirectUrl
methods.description: Generates a Stripe OAuth connect URL with specified state and user info.

methods.name: getStripeAppKeys
methods.description: Fetches Stripe app credentials from the repository.

methods.name: saveStripeAccount
methods.description: Handles saving a Stripe account after OAuth callback, updating credentials.

methods.name: checkIfIndividualStripeAccountConnected
methods.description: Checks if a user's Stripe account credentials are valid and active.

methods.name: validateStripeCredentials
methods.description: Validates the provided Stripe credentials for account activity.

methods.name: generateTeamCheckoutSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe checkout session for team subscription.

methods.name: getStripeCustomerIdFromUserId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a Stripe customer ID for a user.

methods.name: getStripeCustomerId
methods.description: Extracts Stripe customer ID from user metadata.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerId
methods.description: Creates a new Stripe customer and updates user metadata.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a Stripe subscription by ID.
